## Tidepool — Landing Page Build Plan

**Brand system:** Warm off-white background (#FAF7F2), deep ink navy text (#1B2A41), teal accent (#2E8B8B), coral highlight (#FF6F61). Headlines in a rounded display serif (Recoleta-style); body in clean Inter. Imagery: soft wave shapes, warm-graded photos of real small teams, no stiff stock.

**1. Hero** — Split layout: left, headline "Your week, planned like one conversation," subline, teal CTA "Start your week — free." Right, product mockup of a shared week board with team avatars pinned to days. Gentle animated wave along the bottom edge.

**2. Proof strip** — Single muted line: "Trusted by 2,400+ small teams," plus five grayscale logos. Minimal height.

**3. The problem** — Narrow centered column, two sentences. Copy names the pain concretely: seven tabs, status meetings that could've been a board, mystery about who's out Friday.

**4. How it works** — Three horizontal cards: Friday wrap-up prompts → Monday 15-minute sync → live shared board all week. Line-icon style (waves, pebbles). Verb-first copy, second person.

**5. Feature bento** — Five-tile asymmetric grid: week board, capacity meters ("don't overload Tuesdays"), async check-ins, Slack/Calendar sync, auto-carryover of unfinished work. One benefit-led headline per tile, one supporting line.

**6. The Rhythm** — Full-bleed signature section: Mon–Sun rendered as a tide curve showing team workload rising and falling, subtly animated on scroll. Headline: "Work should have a rhythm."

**7. Testimonial** — One large serif quote from a 9-person studio lead, circular avatar, small studio name. No carousel—single, confident.

**8. Pricing** — Two side-by-side cards: Free (up to 5 people), Team at $8/seat. Teal border highlights Team. Short benefit bullets, no feature tables.

**9. Final CTA** — Full-width teal band: "Make Monday the easy part." Email field + coral button, wave divider above.

**10. Footer** — Inverted deep-navy, three link columns, wordmark, tiny wave motif.

## Tidepool — Revised Landing Page Plan

*Key moves: sharper hero promise, merged "how it works" into one signature section, added stat proof and a FAQ to kill objections.*

**Brand system:** Off-white (#FAF7F2), ink navy (#1B2A41), teal (#2E8B8B), coral (#FF6F61). Rounded serif headlines (Recoleta-style), Inter body. System-level motion rule: waves flow subtly on scroll, never looping distractingly.

**1. Hero** — Split layout. Headline: "Monday, solved by Friday." Subline: "Weekly planning for teams of 3–15 — a Friday wrap-up, a 15-minute Monday sync, one shared board." Teal CTA "Start free" + ghost link "See a sample week." Right: week-board mockup with avatar-pebbles and a Friday prompt overlay. Animated wave at fold.

**2. Proof strip** — "The planning home for 2,400 small teams," five grayscale logos, one micro-stat: "average Monday meeting: 15 min."

**3. The scattered week** — Problem section. Left, two-sentence second-person prose (stale spreadsheets, 47-reply threads, surprise PTO). Right, three tilted "artifact" cards styled like red-annotated relics. Visual mess on left becomes order at section's edge.

**4. The Rhythm** — Signature full-bleed section, now carries the whole story: a tide curve spanning Friday → Monday → the week, three beats along it ("5-minute Friday prompt" / "agenda builds itself overnight" / "live board all week"), wave fills on scroll. Headline: "Work should have a rhythm."

**5. Feature bento** — Five named tiles: Capacity meters ("never overload Tuesdays"), Out-of-office tides, Async check-ins, Auto-carryover, Slack + Calendar sync. Benefit headline + one line each.

**6. Proof of impact** — Large serif quote from a 9-person studio lead: "We cut our Monday meeting from 45 minutes to 15." Avatar, studio name, plus three stat chips beneath.

**7. Pricing** — Free (up to 5) and Team ($8/seat, teal border). Objection-killing bullets: "2-minute setup, no credit card, cancel anytime."

**8. FAQ** — Four accordions, two-sentence answers: Slack depth, calendar read/write, larger-team limits, data export.

**9. Final CTA** — Teal band, wave divider: "Make Monday the easy part." Email field + coral button.

**10. Footer** — Deep navy, three link columns, wordmark, tiny wave motif.
